title: Shenzhen Stock Exchange

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation on the south side of the public plaza, around 15 metres from the lower atrium envelope.

mapIdentity.scope: Native named overall envelope, independent podium, lower atria, upper tower and low plaza geometry. Relations bind the two filled parts of the public podium and tower transition.

note: Arup gives a 36-metre clear plaza, 163 by 99 metre three-storey podium with roof garden and 55 by 55 metre office tower. Native parts fix the 64 metre podium roof, 245.8 metre architectural tower height, and approximate modern grade.
